title: Add tfstate prefixing and ephemeral GPU pool lifecycle hooks
author: Sofia Chen
commits: 3a1f2b6: introduce tfstate_namespace variable and prefixer helper
b7c9d4e: add gpu_pool_lifecycle module with ephemeral pre/post hooks
f2e8a11: tighten IAM role scoping for tenant service accounts
d4f6c22: network: small route table refactor and module inputs
9c0b3f7: tests: terratest cases for state prefixing and rolling replace
a1d5f0c: docs: upgrade/migration notes and example invocations
description:
Motivation: Multiple tenant/private deployments that instantiate identical stacks were colliding in the shared TF backend during concurrent provisioning and upgrades. We needed a lightweight, opt-in mechanism to namespace tfstate keys per-tenant/env and a safe lifecycle hook for GPU node pools to allow fast ephemeral reprovisioning without manual taints or cluster-level interventions.

What this PR does: Introduces a small reusable modules/tfstate-prefix that exposes a tfstate_namespace variable and applies consistent key prefixes to stateful resources and remote state paths. Adds modules/gpu-pool-lifecycle which codifies an ephemeral workflow: pre-hook snapshot (KV cache + node labels), drain/replace plan with controlled max_unavailable, post-hook reattach logic and optional kubelet config rollout. Tightens IAM scoping in modules/iam to create tenant-scoped roles (least privilege) and updates modules/network to avoid route name collisions by injecting the same namespace prefix. Adds scripts/tfstate_migrate.sh that performs in-place remote state rename (S3/GCS) with safety checks and a dry-run mode. Updates installer Helm chart to optionally emit a Kubernetes Job template (charts/installer/templates/gpu-hook-job.yaml) that runs pre/post lifecycle hooks during nodepool rolling operations.

Migration and backward-compatibility: The tfstate_prefixing is opt-in and defaults to an empty string. When enabled, operators should run scripts/tfstate_migrate.sh to atomically copy and rename existing remote states before switching terraform configs to the new prefix. The migration script supports dry-run and verification steps and emits a small plan-level checksum file to validate success. GPU lifecycle behavior is gated behind a feature flag in the module (enable_ephemeral_lifecycle = false by default) so existing deployments are unaffected.

Testing and validation: Added terratest cases that simulate two tenants creating the same resources into the same backend with and without prefixing to validate collision avoidance. CI pipeline validates terraform fmt/validate, runs a parallel terratest matrix on small emulated clusters, and performs a plan-only check against a staging backend.

Operational notes: This change reduces the need for manual state sharding by providing a first-class prefix and a guided migration path. The ephemeral GPU hooks decrease mean time-to-replace a faulty GPU nodepool from ~40 minutes (manual) to ~6-8 minutes in our internal perf tests (dependent on cloud provider).

Related: ENG-2147 tenant private-installer stability work; SUP-942 customer incident that motivated a safe state migration path.
review_comments: Marco Ruiz: Please provide a clear rollback/migration example for the tfstate_migrate.sh script. Concerned about concurrent writes during copy. Suggested adding a global lock key in the backend or doing a pre-step to set a maintenance flag.
Sofia Chen: Responded: added backend lock check and a maintenance-marker output file; script will fail if the backend is not lockable. Updated README with explicit order-of-operations and examples.
Elena Park: Requested tests for the IAM role narrowing to ensure no cross-tenant elevation paths. Also asked to split the iam changes into a separate commit for auditability.
Sofia Chen: Responded: split iam scoping into its own commit and added terratest assertions that verify role ARNs and attached policies do not contain wildcard tenant ids.

Benjy Tan: Noted intermittent terratest failure on CI job 'terratest-ksim' due to flakiness in the emulated kubelet restart; suggested retry wrapper and moved that job to rerun-on-failure in the pipeline.
Sofia Chen: Responded: implemented retry wrapper around kubelet step in tests and adjusted CI to rerun the job twice before failing. The subsequent CI run passed.
release_notes: Add optional tfstate namespace prefixing for private deployments, add gpu-pool-lifecycle module with pre/post hooks for faster ephemeral nodepool reprovisioning, tighten tenant IAM scoping, and provide a tfstate migration helper script.
notes_on_migration: Operators must run scripts/tfstate_migrate.sh in dry-run mode first to validate remote copies. The script supports S3 and GCS backends, verifies object checksums, and will refuse to proceed without a backend lock. Enable tfstate_namespace in terraform var files and run 'terraform init -reconfigure' after the migrated copy exists. Follow docs/migration/tfstate-prefixing.md for step-by-step instructions.
